subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"source".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Source" **is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• The sentence seems to be talking about something that is the origin or starting point of something else, which fits the definition of "source".
 
• **"Gesture" **and **"symbol" **don't quite fit the context of the sentence, as they are more related to physical actions or representations of ideas.
 
• **"Control" **doesn't make much sense in this context either, as it doesn't seem to be related to anything being controlled.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Gesture:** a physical movement made to express an idea or emotion
 
• **Symbol: **a representation of an idea or concept through an image or object
 
• **Control: **the power or ability to direct or manage something
